newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Left cabinet to be announced Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: French Left cabinet to be announced Wednesday.

text.p: France's new left-wing cabinet will probably be announced on Wednesday afternoon, sources close to Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said.

The statement came after the Communist leadership said it had decided to recommend to members that the party participate in a broad-left government following last Sunday's parliamentary election victory.
